text: Greenland Issues ‘Crisis’ Guidelines Amid Trump’s Threats| US President Rules Out Using Force But…Greenland’s government has released a new public preparedness brochure outlining steps to take during a potential crisis, amid renewed rhetoric from US President Donald Trump about taking control of the territory from ally Denmark. The guidance advises residents to stockpile food and water and ensure access to hunting weapons and ammunition.
